card.title: Build a Note From Magazine Letters

a1.cap: Can you write the lowercase string note using letters cut from magazine, using each magazine letter at most once? Return true or false.

lines: Can you write the lowercase string note using letters cut from magazine, using each magazine letter at most once? Return true or false.

a1.cap: For example, with note = "aa", magazine = "aab", the answer is true.
a1.say: For example, with note equals "aa", magazine equals "aab", the answer is true.

a1.cap: Count the letters available in the magazine. Then spend one count for each letter of the note; if any count would go negative, the note can't be built.
Let's walk through it with note = "aab", magazine = "baa".
a1.say: Let's walk through it with note equals "aab", magazine equals "baa".

a1.cap: Every letter of the note was available.
Time complexity is O(n + m) and extra space is O(1).
a1.say: Time complexity is O of n plus m and extra space is O of one.

a1.cap: That's the Counting approach. Now try writing it yourself, in Java or Python!
